quotes.MPM-20-SPEC p.2 OUTPUT (MPM-20-24): DC VOLTAGE 24V; RATED CURRENT 0.9A; RATED POWER 21.6W
quotes.MPM-20-SPEC p.2 PROTECTION: OVER TEMPERATURE Protection type : Shut down o/p voltage, recovers automatically after temperature goes down
quotes.MPM-20-SPEC p.2 NOTE 1: All parameters NOT specially mentioned are measured at 230VAC input, rated load and 25℃ of ambient temperature.
quotes.MPM-20-SPEC p.3 Derating Curve: x-axis 'AMBIENT TEMPERATURE (℃)', '(HORIZONTAL)'; 12V~24V: 100 % to 55, 70 % at 60, 50 % at 70, 30 % at 85, vertical at 85 (200 dpi render)
quotes.MPM-20-SPEC p.3 Output Derating VS Input: 100 % from 100 VAC to 264 VAC; 80 % at 80 VAC
quotes.MPM-20-SPEC p.4: Mechanical Specification (Unit: mm, tolerance ± 0.5 mm) Case No.219A: 52.4, 27.2, 24; 'P/N diameter:1.04'; pin length 3.5 +1/-0.5 mm
quotes.PCB_EN p.1 (4): Allow good ventilation for the unit in use to prevent it from overheating. Also, a 10-15 cm clearance must be kept when the adjacent device is a heat source.
quotes.PCB_EN p.1 (5): Mounting orientations other than standard orientation or operate under high ambient temperature may increase the internal component temperature and will require a de-rating in output current.
quotes.PCB_EN p.2 Warning (3): Please do not install power supplies in places with high ambient temperature or near fire source. Please refer to the specifications about the maximum ambient temperature limitations.
quotes.not published: no case temperature limit, Tc point, pin limit, OTP threshold, efficiency-vs-load curve, or the position at which 'ambient' is measured (p.1-p.4, PCB_EN p.1-p.2)
